outcome: breathing effort (minute volume, tidal volume, respiratory rate)
cohort: The study included 92 premature infants (46 with clinical chorioamnionitis and 46 matched controls) born at less than 30 weeks' gestation.
finding: Clinical chorioamnionitis is associated with reduced spontaneous breathing effort and poorer oxygenation in premature infants immediately after birth.
gest_age: median (IQR) 26+4 (25+0 - 27+6) weeks for CCA infants and 26+6 (25+1 - 28+3) weeks for controls (all <30 weeks' gestation)
